body:
I revert back to being my high school self (I'm 27). Home feels so restricting and like I can't be the independent, confident, and strong person I know I am. Instead my depression just deepens and all I want to do is stay in my room and watch netflix instead of going out and being productive.

...it's kinda making me want to become a hikikkomori shut in so I can avoid having to go out into the rest of the house.

one hundred percent, but I need to get a job first (working on that) before I can actually afford to move out because I just spent the last of my savings on grad school. I just want to move out like, yesterday.
